E0750

`{effect}` is not a declared effect leaf.

What

`{effect}` is not a declared effect leaf.

Why

This package view has declared leaves under the same root, so dotted effect names must match one of those declarations exactly.

Fix

use the suggested declared leaf, add an `effect {effect}` declaration, or use the bare root.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0750: tests/ui/effect_leaf_undeclared.stderr.

Error [E0750]: `Log.Aduut` isn't a declared effect
  --> tests/ui/effect_leaf_undeclared.jet:3:15
    |
  3 | fn record() -[Log.Aduut]> {}
    |               ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the `Log` root has declared leaves, so every leaf under it must resolve to one declared name
 Fix: did you mean `Log.Audit`?
